name: R&B
description: An R&B song: verses that lift through pre-choruses into choruses, a bridge, and a final chorus. 80 bars.

sections.name: Intro
sections.tip: Chords and a hint of the vocal, or a filtered version of the chorus.

sections.name: Verse
sections.tip: A laid-back groove under the vocal: leave room for the voice.

sections.name: Pre-chorus
sections.tip: Change the chords or add a pad to lift into the chorus.

sections.name: Chorus
sections.tip: The hook: fuller drums, harmonies and the widest chords.

sections.name: Verse
sections.tip: The second verse can add a counter-melody or ad-libs.

sections.name: Pre-chorus
sections.tip: Lift again, a little higher than the first time.

sections.name: Chorus
sections.tip: The hook again, with more layers.

sections.name: Bridge
sections.tip: New chords or a key change; strip back before the last chorus.

sections.name: Chorus
sections.tip: The last chorus: everything, with ad-libs on top.

sections.name: Outro
sections.tip: Fade the groove out, or end on the chords.
